specification_compliance: The .gitignore patterns ignore image and video files under docs/process/reviews/ and re-include everything under <topic>/design/. This matches PROJECT.md:81-83.
Because the patterns ignore files rather than directories, the negation can re-include them. Git's rule that a file cannot be re-included under an excluded parent directory does not apply here.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Media formats not listed (.mov, .avif, .svg, .mkv) would still be committed if R-5 produced them. None exist under docs/process/reviews/ today.

The negation `/docs/process/reviews/*/design/**` matches design/ only directly under a topic directory. A design/ nested deeper, such as <topic>/r1/design/, would have its images ignored. No such layout exists today.
regression_risks: A .gitignore entry does not untrack files already in the index. The 3,000+ PNGs under docs/process/reviews/*/shots/ in the working tree stay tracked unless a separate commit (presumably 4fa9fda0b) removed them from the index.

untracked_paths in review.sh and the frontend gate both use `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`. review.sh already filters out docs/process/reviews/, so ignoring those files does not change which files it treats as reviewed.
